item.title: Umeda Sky Building Guide: The Floating Garden Observatory
item.description: One of Osaka’s boldest pieces of architecture, the Umeda Sky Building is two 40-storey towers joined at the top by a doughnut-shaped Floating Garden Observatory seemingly suspended in mid-air. Glass escalators cross the open void between the towers to reach the rooftop, where an open-air deck gives a 360-degree panorama over the whole of Osaka — spectacular at sunset and after dark. Frequently listed among the world’s great buildings, it’s the city’s best skyline viewpoint and an experience in itself.
